threat_event: Ransomware enters through the B2B integration hub, spreads to the TOS at all 9 terminals and steals data from all three divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One hub serves three divisions; one hub service account can write to every division's inbound folders; 11 partner credentials shared across divisions; Gulf terminals flat and unmonitored
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on all IT hosts; immutable backups; PAM
treatment_plan: Separate hub flows and service accounts per division; retire shared partner credentials and FTP; Gulf migration; cross-division tabletop of the P08 scenario

threat_event: Terminal customer data is shared with the group's trading affiliate and affiliate truckers get preferred appointments
threat_source: Process and access design (affiliate role and appointment rules)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 212 Freight Trading users hold the group logistics TOS role; reserved slots at T3 and T5 with no documented operational reason; no affiliate data-sharing rule
existing_controls: Quarterly access certification (reviewed by the wrong managers)
treatment_plan: Remove the role; cargo-owner view through SYS-T6; documented appointment rules applied to all truckers; affiliate data-sharing standard; legal review of exposure

threat_event: A shared-service incident misses one or more Coast Guard, DoD, SEC, state or contractual notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single notification matrix not exercised; nine facilities each have immediate reporting duties; different clocks across divisions
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee; division IR annexes
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15; out-of-band contact lists

threat_event: Coast Guard finds a terminal not compliant with Subpart F, or a Cybersecurity Plan is late or disapproved
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alternate CySOs or draft Plans for T7 to T9; longshore training at 58%; OT training only at T5; Cybersecurity Assessments not started
existing_controls: Division CySO designated; Subpart F program office; drafts for T1 to T6
treatment_plan: Designate T7 to T9 alternates; Assessments for all 9 by 2027-03-31; submit Plans by 2027-04-30; longshore and OT training plan with the hiring halls

threat_event: Port Real Estate controls are assumed but not shown to operate; division supplement drifts from group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance not documented for Port Real Estate; supplement last aligned 2023
treatment_plan: Document inheritance; realign the supplement; division sample in P07
owner: Port Real Estate security and compliance lead

threat_event: Attackers use third-party remote access into OT and building systems across divisions
threat_source: Criminal or nation-state actors through vendor or integrator accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on crane vendor access at T7 to T9; 31 internet-exposed building system sites run by 5 integrators; neither monitored
existing_controls: Group jump host used at T1 to T6
treatment_plan: All vendor and integrator access through the group jump host; SOC monitoring; contract terms

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a supplier payment, closing wire or customer refund
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High-value payments in all divisions; 2026-03 attempt on a $2.4 million closing wire stopped only by callback
existing_controls: Callback for changed bank details; MFA; mail filtering
treatment_plan: Payment change verification in SYS-G5 for all divisions; vendor bank-detail portal; quarterly payment fraud drills

threat_event: DoD contract noncompliance: CUI handled outside any NIST SP 800-171 environment and FCI outside the affirmed Level 1 scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SP 800-171 environment; no CUI or DFARS reporting procedure; FCI in SYS-F2 outside the SPRS scope
treatment_plan: Re-scope and re-assess Level 1 including SYS-F2; CUI handling decision (enclave or decline CUI work); DFARS incident procedure
owner: Freight Trading federal contracts compliance manager

threat_event: AI makes or drives operational and legal decisions without governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic ASC job sequencing at T5 without safety case or approval; generative AI contract tool with counterparties' confidential terms

threat_event: Compromise of the group identity platform gives an attacker access to every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform; 45,000 users plus partner accounts
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA and just-in-time PAM for administrators; SOC monitoring; break-glass accounts
treatment_plan: Tiered administration model; quarterly break-glass test (in place); identity threat detection tuning

threat_event: The Gulf terminals stay on legacy systems longer than planned and remain the group's weakest point
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Migration to SYS-T1 and standard OT zones due 2027-06-30; flat networks; local logs and backups
existing_controls: EDR on IT hosts at the Gulf terminals
treatment_plan: Group-funded migration program; interim offsite immutable backups and SIEM log forwarding by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Provider A regional outage stops the TOS for T1 to T6, the customer portal and the integration hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single primary region; warm replica in provider B
existing_controls: Warm replica in provider B; failover tested 2026-05 for SYS-T1
treatment_plan: Add SYS-G4 and SYS-T6 to the provider B failover plan; test yearly

threat_event: The disclosure committee determines materiality too late or on incomplete facts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Incident facts come from three divisions and the SOC; materiality criteria not tested
treatment_plan: Materiality criteria and an evidence pack template; include the committee in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts the Florida and Gulf ports at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminals at 5 ports in hurricane-exposed states; Gulf terminals host their own TOS servers
affected_asset_or_process: All terminals; T7 to T9 server rooms
existing_controls: Hurricane plans under each FSP; cloud TOS for T1 to T6
treatment_plan: Move SYS-T1L to the cloud TOS (GR-11); pre-season recovery rehearsal each June

threat_event: A shared-services administrator misuses privileged access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Few people hold broad rights in shared services
existing_controls: Just-in-time PAM; session recording; background checks
treatment_plan: Accepted with current controls; reviewed yearly

threat_event: The B2B integration hub fails or must be rebuilt and three divisions lose partner exchanges at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single hub; full rebuild never tested; RTO 4 h unproven
treatment_plan: Full rebuild test in provider B by 2027-01-31; partner re-onboarding runbook

threat_event: Backups for some critical systems are not protected or tested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-T1L backups local only; T5 equipment control system restore untested; building controller configurations held by integrators
existing_controls: Immutable vault for cloud workloads; quarterly SYS-T1 restore tests
treatment_plan: Extend the vault to SYS-T1L and the T5 equipment control system; obtain building controller configurations

threat_event: Sensitive security information (Cybersecurity Plans, FSPs, network maps) is disclosed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI held in shared files across terminals and the program office
treatment_plan: SSI library with need-to-know access and DLP rules
